subject: Comprehensive Johnny verification: All features working together
description:
Comprehensive verification that all Johnny features work correctly together in Agent Hub.

**Project:** Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/)

**Verification Checklist:**

**Backend:**
- [ ] All /api/johnny/* endpoints respond correctly
- [ ] Database tables renamed and working
- [ ] Graphiti integration functional
- [ ] Session tracking works
- [ ] Observation capture from all sources
- [ ] Summary generation works
- [ ] Privacy filtering works
- [ ] SSE streaming works
- [ ] Analytics aggregation correct

**Frontend:**
- [ ] /johnny page loads in Agent Hub
- [ ] All 5 tabs functional (Episodes, Timeline, Sessions, Capture, Analytics)
- [ ] Episode CRUD operations work
- [ ] Search/filter works
- [ ] Real-time capture stream connects
- [ ] Charts render in Analytics

**Integration:**
- [ ] Claude Code plugin captures observations → Agent Hub
- [ ] SummitFlow events captured → Agent Hub
- [ ] Agent Hub chat captured
- [ ] Cross-session continuity injects correctly
- [ ] Task-level scoping works

**Quality Gates:**
- [ ] `dt --check` passes (all quality checks)
- [ ] All tests pass
- [ ] No TypeScript errors
- [ ] No Python type errors
- [ ] `rebuild.sh` completed (in agent-hub)
- [ ] E2E verification in browser

**Context Check:** If >= 60%, /compact first. If >= 75%, /commit_it then /compact.

**Completion:** Run /commit_it after all verifications pass.
